birth.original_date_text: 约1494年（学者有争议，范围约1482–1505年）
birth.conversion_note: scholarly debate; common range 1494–1498, with 1494 most cited in Western scholarship

death.conversion_note: 1552 is the most broadly accepted death year across Chinese and Western scholarship

short_description_zh: 明代职业画家，工笔青绿山水与仕女人物画代表人物，后世列为明四家之一。出身漆工，拜周臣为师，得项元汴等藏家供养。
short_description_en: Ming dynasty professional painter renowned for meticulous gongbi blue-and-green landscapes and figure paintings; posthumously classified as one of the Four Masters of the Ming. Rose from lacquer artisan origins, studied under Zhou Chen, and was patronized by leading collectors including Xiang Yuanbian.
